notes: Chrysanthemum is a Kevin Henkes mouse character — generic Boardmaker mouse will not match the distinctive illustrated style. Key themes are name identity, teasing/bullying, feeling sad then happy, and a loving teacher (Mrs. Twinkle). 'Tease' is central to the plot. 'Perfect' and 'special' are key story words used to reassure Chrysanthemum about her name. Several existing activity_images icons (flower, name tag, school, heart) align well with the fringe vocabulary. 'Name tag' can serve as the icon for 'name'.
